profile.name: Matthew Grinaker
profile.title: AI Product Engineering Lead · CTO · Agentic Systems
profile.summary: Software engineering leader with 10+ years designing, building and running production software across enterprise SaaS, automation, trade finance and mission-critical industrial systems. Since 2025 I've been building AI agent systems that are useful, reliable and accountable in real business operations.

brand.pitch: I help businesses take an idea all the way to production software, and put AI agents to work in their day-to-day operations with the controls that make them safe to rely on.

services.name: Tech Consulting
services.detail: Technical direction and roadmaps for client and in-house products across trade finance, ERP, logistics, property and industrial automation.

services.name: AI work processes

now.headline: Growing StockChain, live with its first customer in 7 months
now.detail: StockChain is a multi-interface trading platform built for traders, logistics, investors, suppliers, merchants and customers. It covers the whole deal and trading flow, from RFQ to payment, and connects every touchpoint into one visible story. Built-in intelligence streamlines operations, workflows and deal pipelines, giving insight to every seat at the trading table.

now.headline: Rolling out a shared second brain for the team's AI agents
now.detail: One place for decisions, rules, handovers and work claims, so every agent session starts from the same picture.

now.title: Work-life balance
now.headline: Making room for work-life balance
now.detail: Letting well-governed AI agents carry more of the routine work, so there's more time for family, health and rest, and better thinking when it counts.
now.highlight: More time for family, health and rest

now.headline: Running my agent fleet from one control room
now.detail: See and steer every AI coding session from one page, and answer agents from Slack when away.
